scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.lint: EC_VERSION=v4.0.2 editorconfig-checker && EC_VERSION=v4.0.2 editorconfig-checker -config .editorconfig-checker.exceptions.json -disable-indentation Makefile && prettier --check .
